title: Chaitanya English School
client: Chaitanya English School & Junior College, Badnapur
description: A modern online home for an English-medium school and junior college in Badnapur — from Pre-Primary through 12th Standard.
challenge: Chaitanya English School had no web presence. Parents across Badnapur couldn't find admissions details, academics, or facilities online, and every enquiry had to happen in person or over the phone.
solution: Built a fast, mobile-first site covering academics from Pre-Primary to Junior College, facilities, and an admissions flow with an online enquiry form. Added a live news ticker for announcements, Maharashtra State Board affiliation details, and SEO — deployed to Vercel.
